info.title: Gani Platform API
info.description: Brief Backend & Core v1.0, P9. Session cookie of Better Auth (/api/auth/*); the organisation and workspaces come from the session, never from a request. Errors are RFC 9457 with a snake_case `code` (N132).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` is the stable word (Brief P9).

contactPhone.description: The number customers call ({{company_phone}} of a quick reply, U37); null when not set.

userId.description: Null for an invitation not taken yet.

status.description: `pending`: invited, link still valid; `expired`: invited, link past its 7 days (resend-invite renews it).

expiresAt.description: The end of the invitation link; null for a member.

maxConcurrentConversations.description: The member's own limit of conversations at once (C9); null: the workspace's default applies.

emailSent.description: False when the email could not be sent: the invitation exists, and resend-invite sends it again.

defaultMaxConcurrent.description: The limit of conversations at once of an agent without their own (C9); 5 unless changed.

contactPhone.description: The number customers call: what {{company_phone}} of a quick reply becomes (N163); null until set.

isDefault.description: The team of the workspace that takes what no other rule sends anywhere.

channelIds.description: The channel accounts the team answers (N161).

teamId.description: The team that answers the channel; null: the default team of the workspace.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up (touches no dependency).
Readiness: both databases answer. No reason is given when they do not.

503.description: Not ready.

get.summary: Whether a second factor is required of the signed-in person, on, and must be set up now (N89).
The signed-in person, the organisation they act in and its workspaces they belong to (U32, N145). Ask security-status first.

200.description: `org` is null for a person of no organisation, or of several with none chosen (the other /v1 routes answer 403 then). `name` falls back to the email.

403.description: two_factor_setup_required: the second factor must be set up first (N93).

503.description: service_unavailable: a database did not answer.

patch.summary: Change the name the signed-in person goes by (N162). Answers as GET /v1/me.

200.description: `org` is null for a person of no organisation, or of several with none chosen (the other /v1 routes answer 403 then). `name` falls back to the email.

400.description: validation_failed: the name (1–100 characters once trimmed) or an unknown field.

403.description: two_factor_setup_required: the second factor must be set up first (N93); or forbidden: the request did not come from the application (N136).

503.description: service_unavailable: a database did not answer.

get.summary: The Inbox: conversations of the session’s workspaces, most recent activity first. Sales and support see their own and the unclaimed ones (Phụ lục B, N133).

400.description: validation_failed: a parameter or the cursor is not valid.

403.description: forbidden (marketing, viewer), or a refusal of the edge (no_organisation, org_not_selected, two_factor_setup_required).

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

get.summary: One conversation. Not found and not visible are the same 404 (P9).

400.description: validation_failed: a parameter or the cursor is not valid.

403.description: forbidden (marketing, viewer), or a refusal of the edge (no_organisation, org_not_selected, two_factor_setup_required).

404.description: not_found

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

post.summary: Answer the customer (N146): a text message of the agent, `pending` until the outbound worker sends it. Only while a person holds the conversation, and only inside the free window of the channel (channel-policy-spec §3). Sales and support: one they hold.

schema.description: A key the client makes per action (a UUID); sent again with the same request, it gets the first answer back.

parameters.description: A key the client makes per action (a UUID); sent again with the same request, it gets the first answer back.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: validation_failed: the id, the text or the Idempotency-Key header.

403.description: forbidden: the role may not answer, or not a conversation the person does not hold.

404.description: not_found

409.description: conversation_not_active (claim it first, or it is closed); idempotency_in_progress.

422.description: channel_window_closed with windowState and reason: nothing was written (C-N4); unresolved_variable: the text still holds a {{…}} of a quick reply (N163); or idempotency_key_reused.

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

post.summary: Claim a conversation of the queue or held out of hours (T05, T06). Exactly one of many claims at once wins.

get.summary: The members of the organisation and its pending invitations, with their email, oldest first (#19, N153). Owner and Admin only.

patch.summary: Change the role of a member (N154). Owner: any role of anyone but themselves; Admin: never to or from Owner. The organisation always keeps an active Owner.

200.description: The member, in the new role.

400.description: validation_failed: the id or the role.

403.description: forbidden: not an Owner or an Admin, their own role, or an Admin and an Owner (Phụ lục B); or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: no member with this id in the organisation (an invitation is not a member yet).

409.description: last_owner: the organisation would be left without an active Owner.

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

patch.summary: Set a member's own limit of conversations at once (C9, N156), 1 to 100. Owner or Admin, for any member (themselves too).

200.description: The member, with the new limit.

400.description: validation_failed: the id or the limit.

403.description: forbidden: not an Owner or an Admin; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: no member with this id in the organisation (an invitation is not a member yet).

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

post.summary: Turn off the second factor of a member and end every session of theirs (Q-U20-1, N155). Owner or Admin, never their own, an Admin never an Owner's. An Owner or an Admin must enrol again at the next sign-in.
